inputs.value: ASSET: a stone chest with iron bands and a heavy lid. Footprint 1 by 1 tiles, about 1 tile tall.
ART STYLE: detailed 16-bit pixel art. Crisp square pixels, dark outlines, soft cel shading with light dithering, slightly chunky proportions. No blur, no smooth gradients.
WORLD: dark fantasy. Crypts, stone ruins, candlelight, worn iron and old bone. Use only these colours and close tints of them: #2b1e3d, #4a3168, #7b4fa8, #c09bd8, #f2e3c6.

RULES: one game prop sprite for a 2D isometric game in 2:1 game projection: ground edges rise 1 pixel for every 2 across (about 26.6 degrees, not 30), vertical edges stay vertical, parallel lines stay parallel, no perspective. The front faces the lower-right of the image. Whole object visible, centred, empty margin all round. Lit from the top-left. Transparent background. No floor, no ground patch, no cast shadow, no people, no text or lettering.
